title: A reply from the MettleUp team reaches only the phone that asked, and only for 30 days
what: Help and feedback asks for no email or number. The team's reply is fetched only by the phone that sent the question, using an id made on that install, and only for questions sent in the last 30 days. A member who erases the app, moves to a new phone, or gets a late reply never sees it, and the team has no other way to reach them.
expected: A member can leave an optional way to be reached, or the team can see that a reply will never arrive and close the question some other way.
how_often: every reply sent after 30 days, or after the member changes or resets the phone
fix_line: Offer an optional email or WhatsApp number in the help box, and show the team when a reply cannot reach the phone

title: Gym sync sign-in has no way back for a forgotten password
what: Connecting to the gym with email, password and gym code, and signing in again after the session ends, asks only for email and password. There is no forgotten password link and no line saying who to ask, so a member who forgot the password cannot reconnect. This card is behind a switch today.
expected: A forgotten password link, or a line naming who helps, beside the password box.
who: members using gym sync, once it is switched on
how_often: every time a member forgets the password
fix_line: Add a forgotten password link before this card is switched on
